title: lobelia ceratophylla
intro: Lobelia ceratophylla, commonly known as Indian tobacco or water lobelia, is a plant species belonging to the family Campanulaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and anxiety, improve respiratory health, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Lobelia ceratophylla are attributed to its ability to act as a bronchodilator, relax smooth muscles, and exert a sedative effect. The bioactive constituents of this plant include lobeline, lobelanine, and other alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
